string-array.name: daily_focus_strong
string-array.item: You feel clear and like yourself
You can beat a stubborn problem
Luck and good advice find you

string-array.name: daily_tips_strong
string-array.item: Start the thing you have put off\nTrust your own judgement
Talk plans or money with family\nKind words open doors
Make the call or send the message\nA short trip goes well
Spend time with family\nTidy one corner you love
Learn something new\nPlay, or help a child learn
Do the hardest task first\nClear a pending task or dispute
Plan something together\nGood for a meeting or a deal
Look into what you are curious about\nStudy and research go well
Ask a teacher or elder for advice\nRead, pray or reflect
Show your effort; people notice\nGood for a work talk or a pitch
Reach out to a friend\nA small gain is likely
Give time or help to someone\nSleep early tonight

string-array.name: daily_focus_steady
string-array.item: Mind your money and your words
Keep it simple, stay close to home

string-array.name: daily_tips_steady
string-array.item: Keep to your routine\nLook after your health
Spend with care; small savings add up\nSpeak gently at home
Finish one task you started\nSend that short message
Choose comfort over rush\nKeep plans light
Try an idea just for fun\nCheck details before you decide
Keep up your daily habits\nClear one small obstacle
Hear people out before you reply\nA small kindness goes far
Small changes may come up\nKeep important papers in order
Read, reflect or pray\nAsk an elder one question
Do today\'s work well\nPlan tomorrow before you stop
Message a friend\nTake one step towards a wish
Rest when you can\nLet go of one thing that no longer helps

string-array.name: daily_focus_gentle
string-array.item: Think before you speak or spend

string-array.name: daily_tips_gentle
string-array.item: Eat well and rest\nKeep the day light
Finish old things; don\'t start new ones\nHold off on big purchases
Short, simple tasks are best\nSkip what can wait
Keep talks calm\nPlan a quiet evening
Enjoy simple pleasures\nAvoid big bets and risks
Don\'t overdo work or exercise\nRest is part of the plan
Leave big talks for another day\nGive people some space
Finish old work\nDouble-check before you sign
Things may move slowly\nA short prayer or quiet moment helps
Do what is on your plate\nHold off on big career moves
Wishes can wait a day\nSay thanks to a friend

string-array.name: daily_tara
string-array.item: Go gently and check in with yourself
Good for money and practical plans
Look after your health and comfort
Be patient; you will get through
A lovely time to begin something

string-array.name: daily_vara
string-array.item: Look after your mind and your mood
Good for learning, writing and trade
Enjoy beauty, art and good company

string-array.name: daily_rahu_tip
string-array.item: Keep new starts outside Rahu kaal. Use it to plan the rest of your good day.
Use Rahu kaal for routine work, and start new things before or after it.
Rest or finish small tasks during Rahu kaal. Leave anything new for later.
